fieldValues.title: Where your essay lives
fieldValues.summary: While you work, a recovery copy lives in this browser. **Save to…** writes it to a file on your device, Dropbox or Google Drive (GitHub when the essay was opened from GitHub).
fieldValues.explanation: The browser copy is per-browser and is cleared by "Open another". A device file downloads, and the next Save asks again. A cloud copy becomes the open document.
